intro: Ten stages, in the order this guide recommends playing them. The shape is deliberate: story first with good habits switched on, every treat-as-missable trophy swept before the final mission, and the counters and collectibles — which cannot be missed — left for a relaxed post-story grind where nothing can lock you out. Estimated 90–120 hours for the platinum, most of it in stages 7 to 9.
pointOfNoReturn: The final story mission. Before you start it, clear every trophy in stage 5: partner trophies, one-off moments and all six stranger finales. Park a manual save in its own slot first — that save is your way back to a Leonida where everyone is still where the story left them.

stages.summary: Play the prologue and Chapter 1 at story pace. The trophies here are unmissable; what matters is switching on the habits that make later counters free: register vehicles you like, drive a different car every day, and never skip an optional conversation, because choices are a tracked counter.
tips: Start the 500-choice counter (Actions Speak Louder) from the first dialogue — it only ever lags if you skip optional talk.
Every new vehicle you enter feeds the 100-vehicle discovery count. Variety now is grind you never do later.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — Learn the State

stages.summary: Finish Chapters 2 and 3 and their set-piece missions. As the activity map opens, sample each of the 9 activity types once for Master of None, and complete one arcade game while cabinets are still a novelty rather than a chore.
tips: Tick off activity types as their icons appear; the arcade cabinet is the one everyone forgets.
Neighbourhoods you visit for Headliners are dense with collectible cards and WAiNK spots — sweep them while you are there.
stages.title: Chapters 2–3 — Vice City Opens

stages.summary: Complete Chapter 4 and the airport and late-story missions. Stranger strands are now appearing across the state: accept every one you meet, and finish stages as they ripen instead of stockpiling them. Start the strands whose finales this guide flags, but do not force them — they advance on in-game days.
tips: Remember the airport layout from VCIA Takedown — Catch Me If You Can reuses it in free roam.
Practise Combat Focus target-switching in loud missions; Gunslinger asks for five takedowns in one use.
stages.title: Chapter 4 — Strands Begin

stages.summary: While Lucia and Jason are travelling together by default, earn the two partner trophies. Both need your partner beside you and a wanted level managed on purpose, which the story guarantees now and the epilogue may not.
tips: Hot Together: reach 4 stars together, then hide and go quiet instead of outrunning the radius.
Retail Therapy: pick three shops in one district and keep the wanted level alive between them; escape only after the third.
stages.title: Partners in Crime

stages.summary: Stop before the final mission and clear everything this guide flags. Finish all six stranger finales and the Strangers & Freaks silver, take the Ocean Beach cocktail, do the showroom smash if a mission staged it, watch for the strange encounter at night, and use a deliberate fail-then-retry for Bad Luck, I Guess.
tips: Make the manual save first. It turns every flag in this stage from a risk into a choice.
Strand stages sometimes need a day or a phone call to trigger — sleep in-game rather than waiting in real time.
stages.title: Point of No Return — The Missable Sweep

stages.summary: Play the finale and take the story's gold. Nothing after this point can lock you out of the remaining list, because everything left is a counter, a collectible or a repeatable crime.
tips: Let every scene play out fully on this run — Personal Best is a partner moment, and the finale is full of them.
stages.title: The Final Mission

stages.summary: Work the completion checklist in the game's stats screen, mirrored in this tracker. Shooting-range golds, drone races, race wins, stunts, challenges and meditation spots are the bulk of it; sweep them region by region with the exploration and photo-spot lists, which cover the same map.
tips: Ranges and races never close — if one gold is frustrating, move on and come back with better gear.
Combine meditation spots, WAiNK viewpoints and area exploration into single district sweeps.
stages.title: The 100% Grind

stages.summary: Finish the card sets, the WAiNK locations, vehicle discoveries and registrations, and let the money counters close out: launder every marked bill the moment it lands, spend freely on mods, and buy the eight garages as they become affordable.
tips: Work card sets one at a time with the collection screen open; half-sets do not count.
If the choice counter lags at the end, strand and activity content keeps adding choices — never reload to skip dialogue.
stages.title: Collectibles & Counters

stages.summary: The repeatable crime and stunt trophies: silent jewelry, five vaults, an armoured truck, one operation per gang, the Rhino, the airport departure and the melee drive-by. All repeatable, all technique rather than grind.
tips: Plan every escape before the crime starts; the getaway is the only part that fails these.
Fishing against Cal, Bret's hunt and the bowling game also belong to this cleanup if they are still open (20, 29, 46).
stages.title: Crime Pays — The Fun Stuff

stages.summary: When the tracker reads 54 of 55, the platinum is already yours — it unlocks with the last of them. If one trophy is stubbornly missing, it is a counter, not a mission: check stunts, choices and laundered money first.
tips: Export your tracker progress from the app before the final session — a souvenir and a backup in one file.
stages.title: Leonida Legend

title: Roadmap to the Leonida Platinum
